results.title: 750 kilometres for peace: Teajai Travis walks to honour Emancipation Day and empower youth
results.description: A journey of remembrance and hope is currently tracing a path across Ontario as Teajai Travis walks 750 kilometres from Ottawa to Windsor. The month-long trek, which began on July 1, is a powerful tribute to Emancipation Day, commemorating the freedom granted to slaves across the British Empire, while simultaneously striving to build a brighter future for the nation’s youth.
